semantics.function: out = the bit of in whose index equals the unsigned value of sel
semantics.selection: sel=0 selects in[0]; sel=255 selects in[255]
semantics.timing: Pure combinational behavior, no clock or registered latency; output follows input and selector after combinational settling
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior
semantics.initialization: No stored state or initialization requirement

numeric.arithmetic: No rounding, truncation, saturation, accumulation, or overflow

verification.oracle: Independent loop over all 256 positions; select the position equal to sel
verification.directed: All selectors with zero, all-one, alternating, one-hot, and one-cold inputs; walking hot/cold bits with all selectors
verification.random: Deterministic pseudo-random input vectors checked across all selectors
verification.timing: Check after settling; mutate data with fixed selector and selector with fixed data
verification.execution: Icarus v12, -g2012, explicit dev_tb top, finite compile and simulation timeouts, fatal on mismatch

specification_ambiguities: Behavior for X/Z selector values is not specified; no additional requirement is imposed.
